_comment: Permanent redirects only. next.config.js cannot express redirects because
this project builds with output: 'export', so they live here at the Vercel
The 2026-09-03 move: the two flagship comparison pages and two listicles
went from /compare/* to root-level slugs that exactly match what people
actually type into Google ('dm2buy alternative', not 'obizee vs dm2buy').
These 301s carry the old URLs' authority to the new ones — never delete
them, and never downgrade permanent to false.
Both the bare and trailing-slash forms are listed because next.config.js
sets trailingSlash: true, so the canonical form of every URL ends in '/'.
